# data-sa-042

## Task Instructions
Using the beak depth data (bd_1975 and bd_2012) for G. scandens from 1975 and 2012, generate 10,000 bootstrap replicates of the mean for each year (set the random seed to 42). Calculate the difference in mean beak depth between the two years and compute a 95% confidence interval for this difference. Save the results according to the required submission format.
